_rule: HARD RULES. 1) Print BORDERLESS: the art covers the whole 13x19 sheet, media=13x19.Fullbleed. 2) The TITLE IS SACRED: every letter of it stays clear of the frame lip. Take the crop off the billing-block edge and let the billing block go. A 2000x3000 scan is 2:3 and the sheet is 0.684, so 0.53in of height always has to go somewhere; it goes wherever the title is not.
_bias: 0.0 crops off the BOTTOM, 1.0 off the TOP, 0.5 centered. The frame lip hides a further 0.25in per side on top of the crop.
_sources: Must be exactly 2000x3000 AND borderless (cropped to the artwork). A scan carrying the poster's own white paper border reads as proportionally taller and costs over an inch instead of 0.53in, which clips the title.

films.why: title top: crop off the bottom
anniversary line sits 88px from the top; the title has 214px of forest under it, so the bottom is the cheap edge
logo up top, billing block at the bottom: clip the billing block
title sits low but clear: crop off the bottom
title is at the BOTTOM, so the crop comes off the top canopy
